learningGoals: Understand basic spatial words like inside and outside 📦
Identify where objects are placed, like top or bottom 📚
Learn to spot things that are near or far away 🌳
Build observation skills by finding hidden items 🕵️‍♂️
teachingTips: Use everyday objects to show positions, like putting a toy inside a box 🧸
Ask your child where things are during playtime to practice the new words 🗣️
Make it a game! Ask them to find the cat hiding under the table 🐈
Praise them when they use the correct spatial words on their own 🌟

funActivities.title: Hide and Seek with Toys 🙈
funActivities.description: Hide a small toy in the room. Give clues using words like near the bed or under the pillow. 🛏️

funActivities.title: The Box Game 📦
funActivities.description: Take a cardboard box and ask your child to place a ball inside, outside, on top, and at the bottom. 🥎

funActivities.title: I Spy... 👁️
funActivities.description: Look out the window and say I spy something far away or I spy a bird above the tree. Let your child guess what it is! 🌳
